_comment: Closed per-host hook event vocabulary (R4-1), derived from hooks/HOST-EVENTS.md: Claude Code and Codex `hook_event_name` values (sections 1 and 2, observed and configured-but-unverified rows), pi extension `type` values (section 3) plus the two harness marker events the pi capture extension emits. capture.sh and entrypoint.sh export an event name only when it is listed here; anything else is exported as "other" with `event_unknown: true`.
